rules.accepted_credit_types: Any activity meeting the board's criteria (nursing-related content, written objectives, qualified instructor, certificate); activities approved by another health licensing board or health professional association qualify; academic credit counts (1 semester credit = 15 contact hours)
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE is prorated at 1 contact hour per month of registration, so the first (6–29 month) registration period after licensure needs proportionally fewer hours.
rules.carryover: No carryover stated; missing hours may be deferred once to the next period.
rules.audit_note: Licensee confirms CE on the renewal application; keep documentation 2 years after reporting; failing an audit is grounds for discipline.
rules.notes: Renewal by the last day of the birth month, in even years for even birth years and odd years for odd birth years. National nursing certification can document CE.
